lists.name: sample-malware
lists.description: Hand-authored placeholder proving the block_lists ingestion pipeline end-to-end. Not a real threat feed and NOT refreshable: it records no upstream URL, so `fak egresslist refresh` reports it skipped rather than inventing a provenance. Authored in this repo, so it carries this repo's own license.

lists.name: stevenblack-curated
lists.description: The StevenBlack/hosts project's own curated host set (data/StevenBlack/hosts) - the maintainer-authored ads/tracking/malware source that seeds the widely-used unified hosts list. Named `-curated` on purpose: this is that one source, NOT the ~220k-entry unified MERGE of AdAway/MVPS/URLhaus/etc. The unified merge is deliberately not bundled - at ~2.8 MB upstream it would embed ~5 MB of block rules into every fak binary and land as a diff no reviewer can actually read, which defeats the `deterministic and reviewable` property this registry is built on. An operator who wants the full merge adds it as their own manifest entry against the same ingest path.
